text_block_list.text:
Before the Satsuki Sho, Sakura Chiyono O 
wore a tense look on her face.

Because it's a once-in-a-lifetime race. 
And above all, because here stands an 
opponent she refuses to lose to... a 
rival, in order to get closer to her dream 
of the Derby.

Yaeno Muteki for her master—her 
grandfather; Sakura Chiyono O for the one 
she admired; both surged forward, 
sprinting for victory—
